events.title: Soviet intervention
events.note: Soviet forces entered Afghanistan. UCDP records an armed conflict involving the Soviet Union from this date; UNHCR's figures for Afghans in Iran and Pakistan rise steeply from 1980.

events.title: 2002: largest return year
events.note: After the fall of the Taliban government, returns from Pakistan and Iran were the largest in UNHCR's returns data for Afghanistan.

events.title: Regional solutions strategy
events.note: Afghanistan, Iran and Pakistan, with UNHCR, launched the Solutions Strategy for Afghan Refugees, a shared framework for return, reintegration and support to host countries.

events.title: Taliban take Kabul
events.note: The Taliban took control of Kabul. New arrivals in Iran and Pakistan followed; UNHCR's figures for 2022 also reflect a recount in Iran (see Limitations).

events.title: Pakistan's 'Illegal Foreigners Repatriation Plan'
events.note: Pakistan announced a plan to return foreigners without valid documents, with a deadline of 1 November 2023; large returns of Afghans followed.

events.title: 2025: mass returns from Iran and Pakistan
events.note: UNHCR's returns data for 2025 shows returns to Afghanistan on the scale of 2002, mostly from Iran.

limitations.detail: UNHCR's footnote for 2022 says the figure includes Afghans reported as people in a refugee-like situation after a government recount. Read the footnote before comparing 2021 and 2022.

limitations.text: Same figure in Iran for 2017, 2018 and 2019
limitations.detail: The figure repeats exactly for three years, which suggests it was carried forward rather than recounted; the sources don't say.

limitations.text: Many Afghans are not counted as refugees
limitations.detail: Afghans in Iran and Pakistan hold different documents, or none. UNHCR's footnotes say refugee figures differ from wider operational totals.
From 2025 UNHCR also counts some Afghans in Iran and Pakistan as 'other people in need of international protection'. This page follows refugees only.

refugees.reliability: Figures are registered refugees reported by the governments of Iran and Pakistan to UNHCR. Afghans with other documents, or none, are counted differently or not at all (see Limitations).
